clusters.mechanism: Recovery only checks the persisted ctx.state.worktreePath, so a legacy worktree created in prepare before the path was saved is skipped and createWorktree's reuse branch fails with 'Missing trusted Git paths'.
The legacy-worktree recording block runs after the needsHumanReason throw, so resumed needs_human runs reach deliver without a .git-paths record and delivery fails.
The new test only covers resuming in the loop phase with a worktree built under the new code, leaving the delivery/needsHumanReason and pre-upgrade cases untested.
